name: Sealmatic India Limited
summary: Sealmatic India Ltd. is a manufacturer dedicated to the development and production of mechanical seals and associated equipment. Its comprehensive product line includes various types of seals, such as pusher, standard cartridge, elastomer bellows, metal bellows, engineered, split, and gas-lubricated designs. These specialized sealing solutions are deployed across a wide array of demanding sectors, including oil and gas, refining, petrochemical, chemical, pharmaceutical, fertilizer, power generation, mining, pulp and paper, aerospace, and marine applications. The firm commenced operations on December 2, 2009, and is based in Thane, India.
